title: The Handle and the Proof
hook_quote: Close-up of a red oxygen gauge beside a sealed glass door. A woman is trapped behind the glass.
cliff_quote: If I pull it, the proof burns. If I do not, she dies.
why_it_works: The setup establishes a clear, immediate danger with a countdown on the oxygen gauge, and the search for another switch closes off escape routes. The rescuer's choice is concrete and morally weighted, so the viewer is pulled to see which loss the rescuer accepts.
viewer_question: Will the rescuer pull the handle and lose the evidence proving who locked the woman in, or hold it and let the trapped woman die?
biggest_weakness: The cut relies on a few repeated lines of dialogue to restate the dilemma, and the evidence's identity and the locker's real threat are only partly visualized, so the stakes feel somewhat static before the final beat.

[0.00–3.00s] E01-B001 SHOT : Close-up of a red oxygen gauge beside a sealed glass door. A woman is trapped behind the glass.
[0.30–2.80s] E01-B002 LINE TECHNICIAN (Shouting): Her oxygen stops in thirty seconds!
[3.00–8.00s] E01-B003 SHOT : A second woman grips an emergency door handle. A sealed evidence cabinet is wired to the same lock.
[3.30–7.70s] E01-B004 LINE OPERATOR (Urgent): Open her door and the furnace burns our only evidence.
[8.00–13.00s] E01-B005 SHOT : The trapped woman pounds on the glass. The red gauge falls.
[8.30–12.70s] E01-B006 LINE TECHNICIAN (Pleading): That evidence proves who locked her in. We cannot lose it.
[13.00–18.00s] E01-B007 SHOT : The operator holds the handle. Smoke presses against the evidence cabinet.
[13.30–17.70s] E01-B008 LINE OPERATOR (Trembling): There must be another switch. Find it!
[18.00–23.00s] E01-B009 SHOT : The technician checks an empty control panel. The trapped woman drops to her knees.
[18.30–22.70s] E01-B010 LINE TECHNICIAN (Panicked): Nothing. One handle controls both doors.
[23.00–29.00s] E01-B011 SHOT : The operator holds the handle while the trapped woman presses one hand to the glass.
[23.30–28.70s] E01-B012 LINE OPERATOR (Desperate): If I pull it, the proof burns. If I do not, she dies.
